sources.national_sd: SD of cycle-level Senate poll bias 1998-2022 = 2.7 (538 raw-polls.csv recompute); bias correlation between cycles 0.17
sources.regional_sd: Same-state Senate/presidential poll errors correlate 0.51; 538 2024 Senate model used regional 2.8 months out
sources.state_sd: Residual race-level error 3.5-3.9 for races with 5-10+ polls, final 21 days (538 raw-polls recompute)
sources.per_day: Final-7-day averages no more accurate than 8-21 days out (6.3 vs 6.1 RMSE)
sources.single_poll_sd: Single-poll scatter around race average ~4.0 (sampling for n~700)
sources.per_undecided: Judgment: 538 data show little relation; kept small as 538/Silver models widen with undecideds
sources.fundamentals_sd: Prior presidential margin + national swing: SD ~9 if the swing were known, 12-14 otherwise; 12 used since the swing itself is uncertain
sources.partisan_shift: Sponsored Senate polls ran 3.6 pts toward sponsor vs nonpartisan polls in same race (538 recompute); Silver uses ~4
sources.lean_shift: Judgment: one-party pollsters without a sponsor, roughly half the sponsored-poll effect (Split Ticket 2024)
sources.independent_extra_sd: Judgment: thin record for independent-vs-R races (Kansas 2014 miss ~11, Nebraska 2024)
sources.t_df: State errors near-normal (excess kurtosis 0.35); df 6 gives modest fat tails for the national term
sources.national_shift: Generic ballot D+8.7 (Oct 2026 avg) minus 2024 national presidential margin R+1.5
sources.prior_bias: Zero in baseline: direction does not persist; midterm averages near zero (2018 +0.3, 2022 +1.2 nonpartisan / -0.9 all). Tested as scenarios instead.
